 Social Security recipients may see 2 payments this week. Here's why
 Haadiza Ogwude, Cincinnati Enquirer 2026년 10월 27일 화 오후 1:38 UTC 0 Some Social Security recipients may see two payments hit their accounts this week.
 The final round of October Social Security payments and the November Supplemental Security Income payment are both scheduled to go out this week. 
 Here's what to know about upcoming Social Security and Supplemental Security Income payment dates .
 When is the final Social Security payment for October?
 Social Security recipients in Ohio and nationwide whose birthdays fall between the 21st and 31st are set to receive their October payments Wednesday, Oct. 28 .
 When are Supplemental Security Income payments going out?
  Recipients of Supplemental Security Income (SSI) will receive their payments on Friday, Oct. 30. 
 Why are SSI payments going out this week?
 SSI beneficiaries will receive their checks earlier than usual, as checks are typically sent on the first of each month. However, checks will be delivered on Friday, Oct. 30 because Nov. 1 lands on Sunday. 
 The early payment means SSI recipients won't get another check until Dec. 1.
 Social Security payments for November 2026
 Here are the payment dates for Social Security checks in November:
 Advertisement
 Tuesday, Nov. 10, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between the first and 10th.
 Wednesday, Nov. 18, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between the 11th and 20th.
 Wednesday, Nov. 25, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between the 21st and 31st.
 What's the difference between SSI and Social Security benefits?
 Though both programs are run by the Social Security Administration , they serve different purposes. Social Security benefits are earned through work, while SSI helps people with limited income and resources.
 Are Social Security checks late this month?
 No, the payment dates align with the official Social Security Administration payment calendar .
 When does the cost-of-living adjustment go into effect?
 Recipients of SSI and Social Security will receive a 3.6% increase to their benefits in 2027.
 SSI payments will increase starting Dec. 31, while Social Security benefits will see the change in January 2027, according to the Social Security Administration .
 Full SSA payment schedule for 2026
 When are the remaining SSI payments in 2026?
 Supplemental Security Income (SSI) checks are usually issued on the first business day of the month. The remaining payment dates for 2026 are:
 Friday, Oct. 30, 2026 (Check for November 2026)
 Tuesday, Dec. 1, 2026 (Check for December 2026)
 Friday, Dec. 31, 2026 (Check for January 2027)
 How many people get Social Security in Ohio?
 More than 2.4 million Ohioans received Social Security benefits as of December 2023, including more than 1.7 million retirees and over 300,000 disabled workers.
 Social Security offices near you
 Ohio residents can use the SSA's office locator to find a nearby Social Security office.
 Contributing: Alex Perry and Sarah Moore, USA TODAY Network.
